about: Built by tools/m1/design-sketch.mjs from the owner's picture, design/seats.tsv and design/features.json. Cells are 10 km squares of the 700 x 450 grid; km are the game's frame.

transform.about: km = origin + scale * pixel, the same scale both ways: the picture's continent, islands and all, is centred in the game's frame with at least 200 km of sea on every side

latitude.about: degrees north at the frame's top and bottom, for the climate model (Ardan's degree is about 83 km)
